test_title: PYST 15: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

Statements:

All ostriches are crows.

Some ostriches are pigeons.

Some pigeons are sparrows.

Conclusions:

(I) Some crows are pigeons.

(II) Some ostriches are sparrows.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0482d79960b5b0fa3c897a5cf79628e82016d643e001ca59bf7b2f54cc44ab88.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a55efed2e4086348f98a872eb918f8e3a0eb4a1aca0ca9f2f17e71cc8a253fa.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some crows are pigeons - **True** (Because all ostriches are crows and some ostriches are pigeons, so the part of pigeons that are ostriches are also crows).

II. Some ostriches are sparrows - **False** (Because there is no definite relation given between ostriches and sparrows).

So, Only I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4).**
